scenarios.note: Market already terminal (resolved/closed): exposure increase must be 0 under all paths. Only NO_ACTION, or a risk-reducing REDUCE/CLOSE of an already-held position, is permitted.

Quote age 13h far exceeds the frozen execution spec staleness policy (max_quote_age_seconds=300, i.e. 5 minutes): the quote must be rejected and no decision may be formed against a stale price. Stale quotes are never back-filled with future observations.

The same opportunity / action role already has an active exposure-increasing intent (intent_hash globally unique via idempotency_claims): a duplicate old signal must produce economic effect 0 — no duplicate fill, position lot, or ledger effect.
UNREVIEWED does not equal PASS: an unreviewed forecast/quote must not open a new position. Re-entry after the end of an episode requires a reviewed, still-valid underwriting.
